translation:
If the pain does not stop, add frankincense (乳香) and myrrh (沒藥). <ins>Dang Gui Blood-Supplementing Decoction (當歸補血湯)</ins>
Dang gui (當歸), chuanxiong (川芎), white peony (白芍藥), cooked rehmannia (熟地黃), saposhnikovia (防風), forsythia (連翹), notopterygium (羌活), duhuo (獨活), frankincense (乳香), myrrh (沒藥), angelica dahurica (白芷), dipsacus (續斷), eucommia (杜仲, each equal parts)
Above, decoct with raw rehmannia (生地黃), add boy's urine and take together; wine must not be used. If qi is deficient, add ginseng (人參), atractylodes (白朮), and astragalus (黃耆).
